topic: Practical demonstration of steady streamlined flow pattern over object in a smoke tunnel.
syllabus_extract: Practical demonstration of steady streamlined flow pattern over object in a smoke tunnel.
specific_objectives: 11.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the properties of atmosphere, flow over bodies, boundary layer.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of smoke tunnel flow patterns over NACA airfoil; Safety: Ensure smoke density is low to prevent inhalation; Supervision: Instructor monitors flow stability and trainee observation.
intro_questions: What are the three primary properties of the atmosphere affecting flight?
Define the term 'boundary layer' in the context of aerodynamics.
How does fluid velocity change as it passes over a streamlined body?

topics: Impact of Object Shape on Flow Pattern

Introduction to Smoke Tunnel Mechanics

Visualization Techniques using Smoke
Flow Separation and Reattachment Points
Impact of Object Shape on Flow Pattern

topics: Effect of Angle of Attack on Flow
Comparison of Streamlined vs Non-Streamlined Objects
development.content:
Analysis of Boundary Layer Behavior
Identification of Separation Zones
Effect of Angle of Attack on Flow
Comparison of Streamlined vs Non-Streamlined Objects
Recording Observations of Flow Characteristics

topics: Preparation for Next Lesson Video Analysis
development.content:
Interpretation of Flow Visualization Data
Correlation with Theoretical Flow Patterns
Discussion on Practical Applications
Review of Safety Protocols Used
Preparation for Next Lesson Video Analysis

summary_questions: Explain how the boundary layer behaves over a streamlined body in steady flow.
Describe the visual indicators of flow separation observed in the smoke tunnel demonstration.
How does the shape of the object influence the stability of the flow pattern?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the flow patterns observed in this lesson relate to the video demonstration of fluid flow characteristics in the next lesson plan.
